PayrollPaymentBatch.title: Payroll payment batch
PayrollPaymentBatch.description: The humaniq-side record of one attempt to hand a payable PayrollRun's net-pay off to shillinq as a draft SEPA PaymentRun (payroll-sepa-netpay-shillinq). humaniq owns no SEPA/bank-file machinery: this schema is a log of the handoff -- what was sent, when, and the outcome -- never the payment batch itself, which stays a shillinq PaymentRun created via OpenRegister's ObjectService (same instance, never HTTP). `skipped-no-shillinq` and `failed` are retryable outcomes: the referenced PayrollRun stays payable so a later `occ humaniq:netpay:run` invocation can supersede them (design.md D6). At most one PayrollPaymentBatch per run may be `pending`/`created` at a time -- enforced by PayrollNetPayService. `created` means the draft PaymentRun was klaargezet in shillinq -- NOT paid: money only moves after shillinq's controller approves and exports it (design.md D4).

payrollRunId.title: Payroll run
payrollRunId.description: The payroll run this payment attempt belongs to.
payrollRunId.x-notes: Reference to the PayrollRun this net-pay attempt belongs to.

period.title: Period
period.description: Wage period in YYYY-MM, copied from the run for listing/filtering.

status.title: Status
status.description: How this attempt ended. 'Created' means a draft payment run was delivered — not that anyone has been paid yet.
status.x-notes: Outcome of this net-pay attempt. `created` = draft PaymentRun delivered to shillinq (klaargezet, NOT paid). `failed`/`skipped-no-shillinq` are superseded by a retry; the run stays payable.

shillinqPaymentRunRef.title: Shillinq payment run id
shillinqPaymentRunRef.description: The payment run this attempt created in the bookkeeping system.
shillinqPaymentRunRef.x-notes: The shillinq PaymentRun object id this attempt produced -- plain string, NOT $ref, because it targets another app's register (ADR-062 rule 7: only fields whose target exists in this register set get $ref).

runNumber.title: Run number
runNumber.description: The unique reference sent to the bookkeeping system, so the same period is never paid twice.
runNumber.x-notes: The deterministic idempotency key sent to shillinq: HRMQ-NETPAY-{period}-{administrationId}. Doubles as the crash-recovery probe key (design.md D6).

totalAmount.title: Total amount
totalAmount.description: The total of all payment lines.
totalAmount.x-notes: Sum of the payment line amounts (cents-rounded).

errorMessage.title: Error message
errorMessage.description: Why the batch failed or was skipped — for a failure, every payslip's own error, such as a missing bank account.
errorMessage.x-notes: Failure/skip diagnostic; on `failed` carries every line's per-payslip error concatenated (e.g. missing IBAN, shillinq unavailable, stale attempt superseded).

createdAt.title: Created at
createdAt.description: When the payment run was created in the bookkeeping system.
createdAt.x-notes: When the PaymentRun was created (or adopted) in shillinq.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: Which administration this batch belongs to.
administrationId.x-notes: Denormalized administratie key this net-pay batch belongs to (multi-administratie, REQ-MULTI-001). Optional, nullable plain string -- NOT a $ref (ADR-062 rule 7). The design.md premise that this payroll aggregate already carried administrationId was inaccurate at HEAD (the runNumber key HRMQ-NETPAY-{period}-{administrationId} referenced it, but the schema field was absent); added here so the Loonadministratie pages scope coherently and nl-administratie-scope-consistency could audit it against the run in a follow-up. Copied from the referenced PayrollRun.administrationId when the batch is created.
